GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 451 (24 Oct 46) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1290)
APO 500
24 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Use of Looted Vehicles for Official Business by the Japanese Government
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 451 (3 Oct 46) CPC/FP, SCAPIN-1248, 3 October 1946, subject “Custody and Storage of Looted Automobiles” from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
b. CLO No. 5338 (PK), 11 October 1946, subject “Application for Exemption from Storage of Looted Automobiles in the Custody of Japanese Government Offices".
2. Pending further instructions authorization is granted to exempt from the provisions of reference memorandum 1a above the following vehicles now in the custody of the First Demobilization Bureau:
a. Ford, 1941 Engine No. K 2061 Body No. Unknown
b. Mercury, 1941 Engine No. K 2059 Body Np. 23 E-1678
c. Packard, 1942 Engine Np. G 5529 Body No. 1382-4794
3. The above vehicles will be held in custody by the First Demobilization Bureau, General Affairs Division, Hibiya Branch, to which they are now assigned, and will be used for official business of the Bureau.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
